pages.text: Having a lot of poppet takes up quite a lot of inventory space.$(br)This is were the poppet shelf comes into play. It allows you to store your poppets in a safe place while still being able to take advantage of their effects.$(br)The poppet shelf keeps the chunk it is in loaded while you are online, unless the server has turned that off.
Only poppets bound to the placer of the poppet shelf will be usable. The poppet shelf also displays the poppets it contains on top of it.
